page_token.description: The signed token that identifies the subscription on the self-service page. Use it on its own only if you build the customer-facing URL yourself; otherwise hand out `page_url`.

page_url.description:
The complete link to hand to the customer. AutoPay builds it from your primary domain, the subscription's language and `page_token`.

Anyone holding this link can act on the subscription, so treat it as a credential and deliver it only to the subscription's own customer. See [Customer Self-Service Page](/developers/payments/autopay/#customer-self-service-page).

schema.description: The customer's current self-service link. Reading it never changes it, so a link the customer already has keeps working.
schema.title: AutoPayPageLinkResponse
